<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/intl-tel-input/17.0.19/css/intlTelInput.css" />
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/intl-tel-input/17.0.19/js/intlTelInput.min.js"></script>
<script>
    document.getElementById('consentement').addEventListener('change', () => {
        const fields = ["numero_tel_principal", "numero_tel_secondaire"]; // List of input field IDs

        fields.forEach((fieldId) => {
            const input = document.querySelector(`#${fieldId}`);
            const countryCode1=document.getElementById('country_code_num_1').value;
            const countryCode2=document.getElementById('country_code_num_2').value;
            countryCodeSetup="";
            if(fieldId=="numero_tel_principal"){
                countryCodeSetup=countryCode1!=''?countryCode1:'BJ';
            }else{
                countryCodeSetup=countryCode2!=''?countryCode1:'BJ';
            }
            const iti = window.intlTelInput(input, {
                initialCountry: countryCodeSetup, // Set default country to Benin
                geoIpLookup: function (callback) {
                    // Fallback to Benin if geo-detection is not required or fails
                    callback("BJ");
                },
                utilsScript: "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/intl-tel-input/17.0.19/js/utils.js", // Required for formatting
            });
            input.addEventListener('countrychange', () => {
                    const countryData = iti.getSelectedCountryData(); // Get the selected country data
                    input.value="";
                    input.value=countryData.dialCode+' ';
                    if(fieldId=="numero_tel_principal"){
                       document.getElementById('country_code_num_1').value=countryData.iso2;
                    }else{
                        document.getElementById('country_code_num_2').value=countryData.iso2;
                    }
                    console.log(`Field: ${fieldId}`);
                    console.log(`Country Name: ${countryData.name}`);
                    console.log(`Country Code: ${countryData.iso2}`);
                    console.log(`Dial Code: +${countryData.dialCode}`);
                });

            // Example: Get the full phone number on input change
            input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                // input.value="";
                    // input.value=countryData.dialCode+' ';
                    // if(fieldId=="numero_tel_principal"){
                    //   document.getElementById('country_code_num_1').value=countryData.iso2;
                    // }else{
                    //     document.getElementById('country_code_num_2').value=countryData.iso2;
                    // }
                const fullNumber = iti.getNumber(); // Get the full number in E.164 format
                console.log(`${fieldId} Full Number: `, fullNumber);
            });
            
        });
    });
</script>
<style>
       #npi {
            filter: blur(5px); /* Apply blur effect */
            transition: filter 0.3s ease; /* Smooth transition when blurring/unblurring */
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        #npi:hover {
            filter: none; /* Remove blur on hover or focus */
            cursor: text;
        }
</style>
